scripts.generate:client:storage: dotnet kiota generate -l CSharp -c StorageApiClient -n Arbeidstilsynet.Common.Altinn.Storage -d AT.Common.Altinn.Publish/openapi-storage.json -o AT.Common.Altinn.Publish/Generated/Storage --exclude-backward-compatible --clean-output --exclude-path "/instances/{instanceGuid}"
scripts.generate:client:events: dotnet kiota generate -l CSharp -c EventsApiClient -n Arbeidstilsynet.Common.Altinn.Events -d AT.Common.Altinn.Publish/openapi-events.json -o AT.Common.Altinn.Publish/Generated/Events --exclude-backward-compatible --clean-output
scripts.generate:client:apps: dotnet kiota generate -l CSharp -c AppsApiClient -n Arbeidstilsynet.Common.Altinn.Apps -d AT.Common.Altinn.Publish/openapi-app.json -o AT.Common.Altinn.Publish/Generated/Apps --exclude-backward-compatible --clean-output --include-path "/*/*/instances/**" --exclude-path "**/data/*/validate"
scripts.generate:client: npm run normalize:specs && npm run generate:client:storage && npm run generate:client:events && npm run generate:client:authentication && npm run generate:client:correspondence && npm run generate:client:apps && npm run generate:client:dialogporten
